mandatoryCriteria: Workspace owner has implicit access to every board in owned projects; nonowners need both active project membership and an explicit active grant on the specific board, and keep their project role's action limits.
Migration creates no automatic board grants for existing members; invitations and project membership do not grant board access. Re-adding a removed member does not reactivate old grants.
Only the owner of the board's workspace can administer board grants. Reject self-elevation, foreign boards, nonmember targets and cross-project access without disclosing hidden resource existence.
Project managers retain permission to create boards in granted projects but cannot grant board access; a created board does not automatically grant access to its creator or other project members.
Project-level identity remains visible to authorized project members with zero boards; board list and all board-related reads and counts exclude ungranted boards before pagination or aggregation.

All mounted board/card/column, comments/activity, images/uploads, imports, trash, notifications, search, tasks, retries and replay entry points enforce the new boundary, including Node and Worker paths.
Revocation serializes with in-flight writes, import commits and image finalization; revoked actors cannot obtain private data via stale IDs, cursors, caches, retries or idempotency receipts.
PostgreSQL migration supports clean install and documented safe restart/upgrade; existing sensitive data is not touched. Test against isolated disposable PostgreSQL, never live data.
Mounted-handler negative tests cover owner, manager, member, viewer, outsider, removed user, stale board grant, sibling/foreign resources, invited owner in another workspace and revocation races.
Typecheck, build, mandatory integration suites and contracts pass on the exact target; a fresh independent review meets every BACKEND_REVIEW_GATE.md category and blocker rule.
scopeAndExclusions: Strict backend acceptance audit of mounted board grants routes and formalized PostgreSQL migrations under BACKEND_REVIEW_GATE.md. Tested exclusively against isolated disposable synthetic PostgreSQL 17 test container flowboard-board-access-review-20261027 on port 55479 with database flowboard_access_test. No production credentials or live data touched.
